hook_line: INDIA CROSSES 1 CRORE HPV VACCINE DOSES IN UNDER NINE MONTHS

hook_stat.sub: HPV vaccine doses administered in less than nine months under the National HPV Vaccination Campaign

stats.label: 14-year-old girls in the annual target cohort — nearly 87% reached
Girls vaccinated in Uttar Pradesh, the highest of any state
Have covered 100% of their identified target populations

diaspora_bullets: The vaccine is free, single-dose and voluntary, given with parental consent at designated government health facilities
A 14-year-old who has not yet been vaccinated can be registered and booked through the U-WIN platform
news_summary: India has administered more than 1 crore HPV vaccine doses in less than nine months under the National HPV Vaccination Campaign, reaching nearly 87% of the annual target cohort of about 1.2 crore 14-year-old girls.
payoff: The campaign offers a free, single-dose vaccine to 14-year-old girls at government health facilities, with parental consent.
